title: Q6
description:
“I will put My laws in their mind and write them on their hearts.”
Read: Deut 6:6–9, Deut 30:6, Eze 36:26–27
a) Deut 6:6 already says, “these words… shall be in your heart,” and 6:9 says to write them on the doorposts. Deut 30:6 promises Yahweh will circumcise the heart. What do these bring forward about what is *new* in Jeremiah's promise?
